dares.text: Say your team's name out loud in your best spooky whisper.
Tell your team your favourite spooky story or film in one sentence.
Stand up, stretch your arms to the ceiling for five seconds, then sit back down.
Do a slow, dramatic ghost wave with one hand for five seconds.
Share a fun fact with your team in your best storyteller voice.
Give a friendly wave or high-five to a teammate.
